The '''MC80 Star Cruiser''' was a line of [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruisers]] in service with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
